    27	 * Grow an array by at least one element, checking for overflow.

    31	static XML_INLINE int
    32	xmlGrowCapacity(int capacity, size_t elemSize, int min, int max) {
    33	    int extra;
    34	
    35	    if (capacity <= 0) {
    36	#ifdef FUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION

    44	    if ((capacity >= max) ||
    45	        ((size_t) capacity > SIZE_MAX / 2 / elemSize))
    46	        return(-1);

    48	    /* Grow by 50% */
    49	    extra = (capacity + 1) / 2;
    50	
    51	    if (capacity > max - extra)
